subject: Anna Callahan Campaign Launch
overview: Medford resident Rebecca Bartorski spoke at a campaign launch event endorsing Anna Callahan for State Representative in the 34th Middlesex district. She highlighted local grassroots organizing and the development of the People's Platform.

items.title: Introduction
items.summary: An opening speaker introduced Rebecca Bartorski, noting her community involvement with Our Revolution Medford.

items.title: Remarks by Rebecca Bartorski
items.summary: Rebecca Bartorski discussed how Our Revolution Medford used grassroots workshops to create the People's Platform and elect progressive municipal candidates, expressing her support for Anna Callahan.
